compatibility.metadata_sufficiency: broad major-version constraints are not sufficient to prove install compatibility
compatibility.verified_install_path: official HRMS v15.64.1 exact commit with one bounded uninstall/clear-cache/reinstall replay after the upstream Expense Claim Type fixture failure, followed by migrate and direct installed-app/role/workspace readback

notes: Frappe is the site platform baseline and is not installed by the control-plane worker.
HRMS is required only when effective module metadata requires hrms; no permanent UI install switch is authoritative.
The production ERP site must not be treated as HRMS-verified until direct installed-app, role, and workspace readback succeeds.
